items.title: Marian McPartland interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, April 26, 1997
items.q: he wasn’t really an uncle he was a second cousin who was the Mayor of Windsor — Sir Cyril Dyson — he and his wife came over

ctx.x: And did they ever have the opportunity to see you doing your thing?

Unfortunately they didn’t. One of my — he wasn’t really an uncle he was a second cousin who was the Mayor of Windsor — Sir Cyril Dyson — he and his wife came over. They had a convocation of mayors or something like that, and he came to The Hickory House. And he really looked appalled. And after the set he said to me, “Margaret! Does your father know what you are doing?” Like I was playing in a brothel or something.
